description: This file defines data models and enums related to daily activity and spend metrics, including classes for metrics, metadata, breakdowns, and paginated responses, primarily used for tracking and analyzing usage data in a system.

classes.name: GroupByDimension
classes.description: Enumeration for different dimensions to group spend data by, such as date, model, API key, team, organization, model group, and provider.

classes.name: SpendMetrics
classes.description: Data model representing various spend-related metrics, including tokens, request counts, and spend amount.

classes.name: MetricBase
classes.description: Base model that includes a SpendMetrics instance, used as a parent class for other metric-related models.

classes.name: KeyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata associated with a key, including optional alias and team ID.

classes.name: KeyMetricWithMetadata
classes.description: Extends MetricBase to include metadata specific to keys.

classes.name: MetricWithMetadata
classes.description: Extends MetricBase to include a dictionary of metadata and a breakdown by API key.

classes.name: BreakdownMetrics
classes.description: Contains dictionaries for breakdowns of spend metrics by various dimensions such as MCP servers, models, providers, API keys, and entities.

classes.name: DailySpendData
classes.description: Represents daily spend data including date, metrics, and breakdown details.

classes.name: DailySpendMetadata
classes.description: Aggregated metadata for daily spend, including totals and pagination info.

classes.name: SpendAnalyticsPaginatedResponse
classes.description: Response model for paginated daily spend data results, including results list and metadata.

classes.name: LiteLLM_DailyUserSpend
classes.description: Model representing daily spend data for a user, including tokens, requests, and spend amount.

classes.name: GroupedData
classes.description: TypedDict for grouping metrics and breakdown data.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Import of date class from datetime module.
